title: Holy priest: Battle Stance control, a hurt non-tank Arms warrior still gets the out-of-combat shield

rules.desc: Control: out of combat, the holy priest still shields an Arms warrior in Battle Stance that sits in the low band above critical
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/HolyPriestStrategy.cpp:89-102 (InitNonCombatTriggers: party member low health, shield first at ACTION_HIGH+2); ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/PriestActions.h:42; ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504
rules.why_expect: control: Battle Stance with Arms talents is no tank (AiFactory.cpp:503 only reads Defensive Stance), so the non-combat low health row's shield-first order stays; a non-tank still gets the out-of-combat shield before and after the round-3 fix

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the out-of-combat window, so the shield rule above is about this stance
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:491-504 (GetRoleFromStanceOrGear); setup check player_stance proves it at the start, this proves it through the window
rules.why_expect: the ooc_hurt runner never clears auras and re-casts the stance when it reads down
